description: The notebook playground gets its own branch. The org preset groups every minor and patch update of a repository into one branch, renovate/deps, which stays red while any other dependency in it breaks the build: here it was red from 2026-10-24, and the playground pin sat at v0.7.1 inside it while v0.16.0 was released. Alone, the playground bump is judged by the checks that build the notebooks.
